name: Senso Electronics
summary: An electronics shop dressed as a calm, cinematic brand site: a clear header over a full-bleed hero carousel, product families with clean mega panels, featured and lifestyle image cards over pale category tiles, offers and new-arrival rails, line-icon category tiles, dark category banners with kinds and a filter card, a product page with a sticky info column, Highlights bands, a two-column spec table and Compare with similar, and a support centre.
